_comment: P2-108 (UIPOSES lane, 1 Nov 2026). GPU item score 28 Oct 4.97: the mounted Aquaryn stands upright on the water in an identical pose with no splash and a long hard shadow on the water, reading as walking on glass. When enabled, a listed mount swimming with a rider sits extra_sink_m deeper (its 5 m body was 4 m above the surface; the seated rider stays above sea level), bobs bob_amplitude_m over bob_period_s, and casts no shadow on the water (scripts/world/water_mount_presentation.gd via water_mounted_swim.gd). Presentation of the existing swim follow only; no stamina, collision, network or save change. OFF until GPU judging.

camera_hide._why: P2-109 (F39#22, GPU 5.62: after dismount 'a ghostly translucent mount mesh hovers around the trainer and a large detached dark shadow fills the foreground'). When on, a body the camera sits inside (the follower, or Aquaryn's world body) is hidden outright with its saddle and blob shadow, and snaps back when the camera leaves, instead of the 0.85 dither ghost (creature_body.gd _tick_camera_fade). OFF until judged.
camera_hide.scope: local presentation only; no collision, placement, network or save change
